positions.name: AtlasRehearsalCadenceSettled
positions.frame: what is the settled operational cadence for Atlas rollback rehearsals?
positions.why: src-1 issues the cadence as a flat directive ('run monthly from now on') and src-3 restates the identical fact as a formalized bulleted spec ('Cadence: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals') — same commitment, same matter-of-fact register, ratified twice in different document forms rather than argued for. src-2 (the aphoristic rationale) and src-4 (the ownership assignment) carry distinct acts — principle and commissive self-assignment respectively — and don't share this cadence-restatement read, so they stay outside this group.
